planes.name: plane-01
planes.eave_note: Horizontal eave spanning above the large arched window on the left wing.
planes.why_roof: Main front-facing sloped roof section of the left wing.

planes.name: plane-02
planes.eave_note: Short horizontal eave segment going backwards from the bottom corner of the front rake.
planes.why_roof: Left-facing sloped side of the projecting entry gable.

planes.name: plane-03
planes.eave_note: Short horizontal eave segment going backwards from the bottom corner of the front rake.
planes.why_roof: Right-facing sloped side of the projecting entry gable.

planes.name: plane-04
planes.eave_note: Horizontal eave spanning over the garage wing, partially visible through palm fronds.
planes.why_roof: Main front-facing sloped roof over the garage and adjacent wall.

planes.name: plane-05
planes.eave_note: Horizontal eave on the far right wing, partially occluded by the large oak tree.
planes.why_roof: Front-facing sloped roof of the rightmost visible wing.

excluded_surfaces.what: Gable wall triangle over entry arch
Background roof peak visible through trees on far right

ambiguities: The projecting entry roof is interpreted as a front-facing gable with left and right sloped sides (plane-02, plane-03). Per spec, the scored lower boundary is the eave (the short horizontal segment going backward from the front corner), not the prominent slanted front rake edge.
